scope: review-only PostgreSQL atomic pre-send shared-key quote attempt reference plus default-absent Chat and Completions bridge

contract.dependencyOrder: 73 formal PostgreSQL migrations, v338 shared-key-quote-versions.sql, v339 shared-key-dispatch-quote-attempts.sql
contract.activation: SET LOCAL cinatoken.shared_quote_attempt_activation = 'reviewed-v1' by direct migrator LOGIN; direct pre-provisioned cinatoken_gateway_shared_quote_attempt_producer LOGIN for claims
contract.atomicClaim: SECURITY DEFINER function takes request advisory lock then active shared-key FOR SHARE lock, selects current immutable quote transition and version, inserts request_log_id and one-based attempt_index with exact quote IDs in the same transaction
contract.lateClaimFence: Claim rejects an existing request log; companion economic outbox proposal must take the same request advisory lock before request-log INSERT
contract.readiness: Chat and legacy Completions create one request-scoped capture from the exact generation/request-log ID. Activation is absent by default. Enabled composition returns 503 before body read when the injected economic producer is absent; shipped runtimes inject none.
contract.captureMeaning: A committed row proves only pre-send quote admission. It does not prove physical send, usage or seller credit.

negativeCoverage: missing activation, disabled immutable quote trigger and no-op trigger function refuse companion installation
third-role access to quote dependency, plus hostile default SELECT/EXECUTE ACL on newly created evidence, roll back companion installation
hostile default EXECUTE WITH GRANT OPTION to dedicated producer also rolls back installation
ordinary runtime and producer cannot SELECT private attempt table; unrelated LOGIN cannot execute claim function
same attempt ID with changed target and same request/index with another UUID reject
competing revoke waits on held Key lock; new claim after revoke rejects while historical reference stays unchanged
claim after request log exists rejects; UPDATE and DELETE of attempt reference reject
invalid activation/backend, missing economic producer, claim error, malformed returned identity and non-delegated use do not send
budget denial after a committed quote capture leaves one pre-send reference and zero physical sends
partition-none global model loop forwards the same request-scoped capture
limits: Only Chat and legacy Completions route options are connected; Responses, Messages, Gemini, vectors, Audio, Images and Realtime are not connected.
No production economic producer implementation is supplied; the opt-in path cannot dispatch when enabled in a shipped runtime.
The future producer must persist typed per-attempt send/unknown/usage facts; the selected final route and request-level usage cannot reconstruct failed or billable earlier hops.
Current recordUsage and settleSharedKeyEarning still use mutable current key price/commission on the default path; no billing change is claimed.
The quote version proposal has seller prices/commission but buyer price and entitlement authority are not wired; C04.1 and C04.2 remain open.
A pre-send claim can remain without a send after budget denial, cancellation or an unknown COMMIT ACK; forensic review, reconciliation and retention are not implemented.
Outbox producer/consumer, formal migration, role provisioning, production grants, Workers/Hyperdrive, MySQL/D1 parity and Linux CI remain unverified.
